hooks.command:
git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 timeout 15 git fetch --quiet 2>/dev/null; c=$(git rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...@{u} 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; a=$(printf "%s" "$c" | cut -f1); b=$(printf "%s" "$c" | cut -f2); case "$b" in ""|0) exit 0;; esac; printf "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"SessionStart\",\"additionalContext\":\"UPSTREAM HAS NEW CODE: this checkout is %s commit(s) behind origin (and %s ahead). Before doing any work or reasoning about this codebase, run: git log --oneline HEAD..@{u} , tell the user what landed, and ASK whether to merge. Do NOT pull automatically -- a pull can fail on a dirty tree or Git LFS and is the users call.\"}}
" "$b" "$a"
